text.en:

<title Refills [G_refill] /> 10% of Magazine Capacity, up to a maximum of 200% Magazine Capacity.

<title Refills [G_refill] /> 10% of Magazine Capacity from reserves every #e${4-#d} seconds up to double the normal capacity. Refill amount is rounded up to the nearest whole number.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Refill Delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.
)

text.en:
<title Refills [G_refill] /> 10% of Magazine Capacity from reserves every #e${4-#d} seconds while not firing the weapon.

Refills can overflow the Magazine up to 100% Increased Magazine Capacity. Refill amount is rounded up to the nearest whole number.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Refill Delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
持续 4 秒没有射击：
<title 重新填装 [G_refill] /> 10% 弹匣，直至两倍弹匣容量。

text.en:
Every #e${4-#d} seconds while not firing the weapon:
Loads 10% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Loading delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.
)
